_doc: Deterministic, hand-inspectable fixture for the bulk-vs-incremental equivalence harness (Phase 2 stage 4).
It is a sequence of CaseData payloads ingested IN ORDER (bulk path) or replayed as one EventBatch per payload
(incremental path, after the Case node has been created with the shared CASE_MERGE statement).
Each payload is annotated with the scenario letters (A-N from the Stage 4 brief) it exercises and the insights
the FULL InsightsEngine is expected to produce once ALL payloads are in (see 'expected_full_insights').
Threshold reminders: HIGH_FAN_IN/OUT need >= 3 distinct counterparties; BRIDGE_NODE needs >= 2 cases AND >= 2 assets;
SHARED_ENTITY needs size(case_ids) > 1; CROSS_CASE_LINK needs a case on the SOURCE phone that the TARGET lacks.
Relationship writers never append case_ids to pre-existing endpoints (pre-existing semantics, preserved).
EQ-E (added at Stage 4 checkpoint): the strict 'relationship between two pre-existing entities' case; expected totals below include it (CROSS_CASE_LINK 3, CROSS_DOMAIN_PATH 5, total 31).

_expect: PRIOR_CASE_LINK (P-A1, PRIOR-A1)               -> scenarios M (via Person) / N (via PriorCase) once replayed
TRANSFER_CHAIN  ACC-A1 -> ACC-A2 -> ACC-A3      -> scenarios F/G/H: the chain is discoverable from b1, b2 or b3
POSSIBLE_CO_LOCATION pairs at LOC-A1 among P-A1, P-A2, VIN-A1 -> scenario K (e1 or e2 anchoring)

_scenarios: A existing entity receives a new case_id (P-A1, +A1, ACC-A1 join EQ-B)
D owner side effect (+B1 declares owner P-A1; ACC-B1 declares owner P-A1)
E cross-case CALL becoming a CROSS_CASE_LINK: +A1 now has EQ-B which +A2 lacks -> the OLD call CALL-A-1 flips
B (partial) relationships whose OTHER endpoint is declared in the same batch (+A1 -> +B1, ACC-B1 -> ACC-A1); the strict case -- both endpoints PRE-EXISTING from earlier cases -- is EQ-E
I fan-in aggregation: ACC-A2 receives from ACC-A1 (EQ-A), ACC-B1 and ACC-B2 (EQ-B) = 3 distinct sources
_expect: SHARED_ENTITY P-A1 [EQ-A, EQ-B]; SHARED_ENTITY +A1 [EQ-A, EQ-B]; SHARED_ENTITY ACC-A1 [EQ-A, EQ-B]
BRIDGE_NODE P-A1: 2 cases, assets = +A1, ACC-A1, VIN-A1, +B1, ACC-B1 (5 >= 2)
CROSS_CASE_LINK +A1 -> +A2 (old call; +A1 has EQ-B, +A2 does not)
CROSS_CASE_LINK +A1 -> +B1 ? NO: +B1 is declared in EQ-B and +A1 has [EQ-A, EQ-B]; +A1 has EQ-A which +B1 lacks -> YES, flagged
HIGH_FAN_IN ACC-A2 (in_degree 3) -- ACC-A2 case_ids stays [EQ-A] (endpoint-only in EQ-B, no append: preserved semantics)
TRANSFER_CHAIN ACC-B1 -> ACC-A1 -> ACC-A2 ; ACC-B2 -> ACC-A2 -> ACC-A3 ; ACC-B1 -> ACC-A1 -> ACC-A2 already counted; ACC-A1 -> ACC-A2 -> ACC-A3 (from EQ-A)
INFRASTRUCTURE_REUSE: IMEI-A shared by +A1 and +B1 (both declare imei IMEI-A)

_scenarios: J fan-out aggregation: ACC-C1 disburses to ACC-C2, ACC-C3, ACC-C4 (3 distinct targets)
L cross-domain path through every position: P-C1-OWNS->+C1-CALLED->+C2<-OWNS-P-C2-OWNS->ACC-C1-TRANSFERRED_TO->ACC-C2
C relationship where either endpoint is touched (calls / transfers reference declared and undeclared accounts)
_expect: CROSS_DOMAIN_PATH P-C1 <-> P-C2 via +C1 -> +C2 and ACC-C1 -> ACC-C2 / ACC-C3 / ACC-C4 (3 paths, distinct b2); plus P-A1 <-> P-A2 via +A1 -> +A2 and ACC-A2 -> ACC-A3 (exists since EQ-A)
TRANSFER_CHAIN: none (ACC-C2/3/4 have no outgoing transfers)

_scenarios: K co-location through either endpoint: EQ-D observes P-D1 and VIN-D1 (new) at LOC-A1 next to the EQ-A observations
N prior-case link through PriorCase: PRIOR-A1 re-used by P-D1 (same record id -> same PriorCase node, second HAS_PRIOR_CASE)
Location referenced only via a surveillance log -> loc.case_ids stays [EQ-A]; the new edges carry case_id EQ-D (preserved semantics)
_expect: POSSIBLE_CO_LOCATION: 5 nodes at LOC-A1 (P-A1, P-A2, VIN-A1, P-D1, VIN-D1), one edge each -> 10 unordered pairs (< LIMIT 20)
PRIOR_CASE_LINK (P-D1, PRIOR-A1) in addition to (P-A1, PRIOR-A1); PriorCase PRIOR-A1 case_ids = [EQ-A, EQ-D]
SHARED_ENTITY: PriorCase/Location are NOT in the SHARED_ENTITY label set -> nothing new

_scenarios: B relationship added between two PRE-EXISTING entities: +C1 (declared in EQ-C) -> +A2 (declared in EQ-A). Neither phone is declared in EQ-E, so neither gains EQ-E in case_ids (relationship writers are ON CREATE only: preserved semantics).
C either endpoint touched: the batch touches exactly {+C1, +A2} + CALLED; the new insights must be discoverable from the target phone +A2 alone as well as from the source +C1 alone.
_expect: CROSS_CASE_LINK +C1 -> +A2  (+C1 has EQ-C which +A2 lacks; asymmetric predicate)
CROSS_DOMAIN_PATH P-C1 <-> P-A2 via +C1 -> +A2 and ACC-A2 -> ACC-A3 (P-A2 owns ACC-A2, TX-A-2 exists since EQ-A)
no SHARED_ENTITY / BRIDGE / fan / chain change; Case EQ-E has no INVOLVES edges at all on either path

expected_full_insights._doc: Expected FULL InsightsEngine output (case_id=None) after all payloads; keys are canonical identities used by the harness. Counts per type.
